facts.fact: A national workshop opened by the Minister of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy in Brazzaville in July 2025 to outline a digital identity roadmap was described as a milestone in implementing Congo Digital 2025, the national strategy for digital technology as a catalyst for inclusive and sustainable development; the article gives its publication date of 21 July 2025 and no event day.
